text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an All-Way Stop Control not be installed at the intersection of Barrymore Road and Kilbride Road as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing the eastbound and westbound approaches on Kilbride Road at this four-way intersection.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Barrymore Road and Kilbride Road.
